function whenFontsReady(onReady): void;

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/dom-font.ts:151

Resolves once the document's webfonts have settled (document.fonts.ready) — canvas rasterizes with whatever font is loaded AT draw time, so a snapshot taken before the face arrives silently bakes in the fallback family/metrics. onReady runs immediately when FontFaceSet is absent.

Parameters

onReady

() => void

Callback fired once fonts are usable.

void
